commuteAccess.summary: S1 has weak start access at Frodeparken and strong end access in Oskarström. Frodeparken is best treated as on-route roadside/shelter trail access with no direct transit and no confirmed formal parking. Oskarström endpoint has a bus stop essentially at the finish, nearby centrum parking and Oskarström rail station within walking distance.

seasonalLimits: Hallandstrafiken directs users to the trip planner/app for stop locations, departures and current disruptions.
Bus-stop times may be approximate and buses may arrive a few minutes early or late.
Timetable exceptions, weekdays/weekends/holidays and footnotes must be checked for the travel date.
Frodeparken rural fallback stops are sparse and often weekday-focused in the 2026-04-29 feed.
Oskarström rail replacement buses use a special stop on Gamla Nissastigen west of the station.
No ferry access relevant to either endpoint was found.

campingAndFire.summary: Official shelter/rest/camping-style facilities exist at Frodeparken and Döbla. Fire is limited by reserve rules and dynamic fire-risk/fire-ban status. Frodeparken reserve explicitly prohibits tenting/caravan/camper setup; use only designated facilities and verify local signs.

camping.status: official start shelter/rest/fireplace/dry-toilet context at route km 0.00
camping.caveats: Frodeparken reserve rules prohibit tenting/caravan/camper setup, fires except at designated places and loose dogs. Fire use is always at user responsibility and current fire risk must be checked.

camping.name: Lägerplats Döbla
camping.status: official shelter/rest/fireplace/dry-toilet context around route km 8.2
camping.water: Döblaån is present but no potable water verified
camping.caveats: Do not model river water as drinking water. Fire rules and live fire status still apply.

fireRules: Use designated fireplaces only and never during fire bans.
Frodeparken reserve allows fires only at specially designated places.
Almeberget reserve allows fires only at specially designated places.
Halland/Halmstad fire status is dynamic; Halmstad page said no fire-risk assessment was currently being made at research date and normal assessment period is May-September.
Check municipality, Krisinformation, Länsstyrelsen and Brandrisk Ute before use.
toiletsAndWaste: Frodeparken shelter has official dry-toilet context and OSM waste/information corroboration.
Döbla shelter has official dry-toilet context and OSM corroboration.
Oskarström public toilet/water location is high confidence but availability conflicts with a temporary closure/vandalism note.
Bins exist only at some sites; do not assume full waste service along the section.

Official difficulty text notes a couple of stiles; close gates in pastures, avoid crops/home zones and keep dogs controlled.

Other 2025/2026 cases were within about 12-135 m around km 2.43, 4.88, 4.98, 9.99 and 14.65.

Use current 2026 official GPX/API. Old Frodeparken-Döbla/Döbla-Ryet/Ryet-Gyltige segmentation survives in OSM, Pacer, Destination Halmstad and Naturkartan slug.
